behaviorChanges: Default ASCII digits become Devanagari in ordinary conversion; decimals retain an ASCII period.
Existing decimal expectation changes intentionally; two new scenarios check digit editing, numeric address cues, Latin engine configuration, English exclusions, and injected paste.
Recognized URL/email digit spans and English mode stay literal; the DOM adapter uses its existing shared engine callbacks.

rawReport.retention: Generated reports are ignored locally; each CI engine report and failure traces are retained for 14 days.

regressionDetection.method: Removed digit conversion in a separate throwaway copy; working tree source unchanged.
regressionDetection.test: real keyboard uses Nepali digits, keeps decimal separators and restores numeric address prefixes

limitations: Playwright keyboard actions use headless desktop engine builds; no installed application or device certification.
Clipboard, composition, and native-input fallback cases inject events and do not establish OS clipboard, real IME, or mobile keyboard behavior.
No assistive technology, accessibility conformance, framework-controlled fields, or rich-text/contenteditable support is established.
These tests exercise an explicitly changed default digit contract; counts are not an accuracy improvement on unchanged linguistic labels.
Source hashes and pinned dependencies identify this run; later source changes require a separate dated record.
Durations are diagnostics, not performance benchmarks.
